correctness.rationale: From original printed system (1), stationarity gives S_n=(1-rho)pi/(L+theta+mu), then S_y=(rho pi+theta S_n)/(epsilon L+mu), E=L(S_n+epsilon S_y)/(sigma_n+sigma_y+mu), with I_n,I_y,J,R determined by a triangular chain. Independently coded symbolic substitution verifies all seven residuals exactly zero and the two displayed nontrivial rational formulas. The source Eq. (7) S_n produces residual -(1-rho)pi theta/(L+mu), and its downstream formulas leave all other formal residuals zero. All assumptions on nonzero denominators are explicit. A separate exact positive fully force-consistent example was constructed with lambda=1 and beta=2960/147, confirming the correction matters at an actual model equilibrium.
residual_risks: Arbitrary lambda>0 does not automatically satisfy lambda=beta(I_n+alpha I_y)/N; the theorem explicitly excludes general existence/uniqueness.
No proof given of the source article’s claimed stability or bifurcation consequences.

checked_sources: Original publisher PDF doi:10.3934/math.2023723 Eq. (1), Eq. (7), Section 3.4 and Appendix A
value.rationale: This is a complete repair of the exact stationary coordinates behind an explicitly stated and subsequently stability-analyzed endemic equilibrium in a published seven-compartment NPI-compliance model, not merely a harmless symbol rename. The source introduces theta as an actual susceptible-class transfer and Appendix A uses its stationarity contribution, while Eq. (7) omits it. For any positive theta and rho<1 the printed vector is nonstationary; the corrected triangular seven-coordinate family identifies the necessary base point before any stability, bifurcation or intervention analysis. The result is independently useful for readers checking the published analytic model and has a concrete positive exactly consistent example. It does not overclaim downstream theorem invalidity.
residual_risks: The correction is mathematically elementary once the discrepancy is noticed; value comes from correcting a published central equilibrium, not from a difficult general technique.
Numerical epidemiological predictions and theorem conclusions are not independently recomputed.

limitations: Positive arbitrary lambda is only a conditional parameter and does not itself enforce beta(I_n+alpha I_y)/N=lambda.
Original source stability/bifurcation results have not been re-proved or disproved.
The finite and symbolic checks do not supply Lean/expert attestation.
Priority is best of knowledge; no unindexed correction is excluded.
